answer_1.quote: Text generation task: prompts encouraging a model's creative output [...] Reasoning/ inferences questions: Tasks involving reasoning, associating at least two facts, drawing conclusions [...] Dialogue generation: evaluating models' abilities to grasp nuances across multiple conversational turns.
answer_1.outputs: Model responses to prompts including creative texts, multi-turn dialogues, formatted tables, and factual answers

answer_2.quote: Automatic Red Teaming evaluation was conducted on 18,656 harmful prompts for the Attack Success Rate (ASR) metric and on 9,724 non-harmful samples for the False Reject Rate (FRR) metric.

answer_3.quote: To assess model performance, we adopt the LLM-as-a-Judge approach, following the methodology proposed by [...] The judge model uses detailed evaluation guidelines and gold-standard references.

answer_4.quote: 70 participants were involved in the annotation process [...] For scalar multi-attribute rating, annotators evaluated each response on a 5-point Likert scale across seven criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Annotations based on seven predefined criteria for response quality
